$comment: Example mapping for scripts/import-users.ts; copy it, do not edit it. Every role key in the export must have an entry here, and a key may map to [] when that role should grant no position: an unmapped role aborts the run. admin_role: values come from NEON_ADMIN_ROLES in src/lib/import/chambers-export.ts. Board keys are board:<body_id>:Leadership and board:<body_id>:Member: map Leadership to the body's director or chair key and Member to its -member or -committee-member key in prisma/seed/positions.json. The two bodies below use placeholder uuids, not real bodies. chambers-iems is a product role that an admin must create before the import. The admin_role entries are a starting point for the Primary Admin, not an approval. Set approvedBy (the Primary Admin's email) and approvedAt (YYYY-MM-DD) once the Primary Admin has approved the mapping.
